text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE landscape 3:2 full-body turnaround sheet: exactly THREE equal-size head-to-toe figures of the SAME character and costume, left strict FRONT, center strict 90-degree SIDE facing right, right strict BACK. All at same scale, height and foot baseline, all hair and footwear visible, arms naturally down. No extra portraits or panels. Character-specific body: 180 cm, slim light athletic build. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Same stone-gray hoodie, darker grey straight-leg cargo sweatpants, silver-grey sneakers, no prints.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 24. Smoky ash-blond short spiky side-swept hair with darker roots. Dark rose-brown narrow eyes, compact oval face, wide forehead, curved thick brows, slightly broad nose tip, small cupid-bow lips, gently pointed but short chin. Peach beige skin. Small graphite ear studs and pale stone-gray textured hoodie without prints. Easygoing confident faint smile, eyes level.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
